GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. joined leader turn. weakened in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind Leaders 3 Lengths 1000m, Under Pressure soon after Straightening Up and weakened last 200m, Tongue Tie again # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m had to be steadied and directed to the outside of another runner, which shifted in when not quite clear. However, when unable to assume the lead the rider was required to come off that another runner’s heels, from that point gelding raced one-paced throughout the event and was left without a finishing effort. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. got up fence turn 3 lengths. weakened # Ordinary Effort
Jumped Ok crossed over to settle outside leader. 2nd turn. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to start. Passing the 75m was momentarily crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went through on fence to lead. shared lead turn under pressure. dropped out in Straight # elevated heart rate
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider explained that his mount was under pressure from the 400m and when it continued to give ground, he did not test it inside the final 200m. A post-race vet exam of the gelding which was beaten 40L revealed the gelding to have an elevated heart rate and poor recovery. Trainer was told that he would be required to provide a veterinary clearance prior to the gelding also being required to barrier trial to the Steward’s satisfaction prior to being permitted to race again. V/C received & Trialed since.
